segments.text: GLAD, yea very glad should I have been to have waited upon you at C――――. But it seems it was not to be. However, if I should return from Glasgow, GOD willing, I shall call upon you; if not, in heaven, in heaven we shall meet. GOD be with you and yours! I am just going off. O these partings! they are cutting. I trust JESUS hath been walking amidst the golden candlesticks. You will hear particulars from others. I have only time to beg the continuance of your prayers, and with hearty love to your yoke-fellow, Mr. C――――, and his spouse, to subscribe myself, my very dear friend,
Yours most affectionately in our common LORD,
